desc: Ideate case analysis: k = number of picks equal to v = nums[i]; only k=1 needs distinctness of the 3 non-v picks; k>=2 always valid; k=0 invalid
Derive O(1) aggregate maintenance (T1, T2, SumC2) for distinct-triple counting with v excluded via T1' = T1 - l*r, T2' = T2 - l*r^2
Implement the sweep with frequency maps and aggregate updates in O(1) per step, compute all case contributions per middle index, mod 1e9+7
Verify the implementation against examples 1-3 and edge cases (all equal values, all distinct values, minimum length n=5, values appearing on both sides with collisions in the k=1 case)
